crossRefs.note: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
“This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be…
“Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have…
Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus…

translations.web: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
translations.bsb: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
translations.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
translations.asv: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
